name: @tellma/core-ui
description: Tellma UI component library — tm-* form controls built on @angular/cdk + @angular/aria, signal-first, Signal Forms native.

Previously raised from 5 to 8. About 1.1 KB is the foundation seams the app shell builds on: TmBreakpoints over five media query lists, TmTheme with its System tracking, the live root Directionality, the translations loader and the touch-size resolver. About 1.4 KB is the ICU MessageFormat interpreter that replaced the eval-based compiler, so messages format under a script-src 'self' Content Security Policy with no 'unsafe-eval'; the old compiler lived in an external @jsverse package outside this measurement, so the app bundle itself shrinks (it no longer carries @messageformat/core and its plural data). The instant and time-zone additions that headroom was kept for have landed: the display-zone, device-zone and clock tokens and the formatting facade's instant, zone-label, relative-time and name members took the measured weight from 7.18 to 7.79, leaving about 0.2 KB.

budgetNotes../popover: Re-baselined from 4.5 to 3.84 when the gate moved to the linked production measure (3.47 linked against 4.13 on the published bundle), keeping the same 0.37 of headroom. The figures that follow are on the published-bundle measure. Raised from 4 to 4.5 for keeping open popovers inside the viewport: the width cap is written from the visible viewport width (100vw counted a classic scrollbar, so a clamped panel ran under it), and the height cap, width cap and inline offset are re-fitted on every scroll and resize while open (the CDK reports a placement only when its side changes). Measured 4087 B before these fixes and 4228 B after (+141 B net); the saving taken in the same change was folding the three fixed-size width rules into one custom property read by the base rule. The entry point holds the fixed sizes, the viewport fitting and the block cap.
budgetNotes../entity-picker: Raised from 10.98 to 14 (the measured size plus 0.1 KB, which is exactly the 14 the spec sets for the multi-picker) for tm-entity-multi-picker and the single picker's emit mode it composes: measured 10.88 before and 13.90 after on the linked measure (14,234 B; +3.02 KB; 13.87 before the review fixes, whose deduplicated selection adds 33 B). The multi-picker class, template and stylesheet are about 2.8 KB of that: two dozen pass-through inputs, the form-field contract, chip labels, the advanced-search diff and its announcements, the keyboard bridge into the chips, and the standalone box on the size ladder; emit mode in the single picker (toggle, keep-open re-browse, the chosen-ids bridge, the multi-pick outcome) is the rest. Savings taken (-0.54 KB): every development warning in both pickers now sits behind the build-time ngDevMode flag, which a production build folds away with its text, instead of isDevMode(), a call it cannot (-0.49); the multi-picker announces through the inner picker's live region instead of its own region, signal and visually-hidden class (-0.05). An app that imports only TmEntityPicker tree-shakes the multi-picker (the treeShakes check), so this ceiling is the whole entry point, not what a single-picker app ships. Previously raised from 10.91 to 10.98 (the measured size plus about 0.1 KB) for two-line rows, label parts with their join check and one-time development warning, the page context and the three glyphs through tm-icon: measured 10.28 before and 10.88 after on the linked measure (11,140 B; +0.60 KB). On the published-bundle measure the same work measured 11.37 before and 12.09 after (+0.72 KB). The Lucide data of check, circle-alert and search is 246 B before gzip, and the inline SVG markup it replaces gives some back; the rest is the result-row template (label runs, the hidden separator, the description line), the two inputs and their row helpers, and the context hand-off. Savings taken (-0.12 KB published): the row's explanation moved from a template comment, which ships in the bundle, to a code comment, and the development warning kept to one short line. The spec sets this entry point's ceiling at 14 once the multi-picker lands; this raise covers only what this work adds. Re-baselined from 12 to 10.91 when the gate moved to the linked production measure (10.28 linked against 11.37 on the published bundle), keeping the same 0.63 of headroom. The figures that follow are on the published-bundle measure. Raised from 11 to 12 for the in-field invalid glyph the picker now draws itself (the field can only append its own AFTER the whole control, which would shove the magnifier sideways every time an error came and went). Previously raised from 10 to 11. The picker measures ~10.5 KB as one eager surface: it is an editable combobox that also carries an async search lifecycle, a text/value resolution channel, three modal pages, and a grid cell-editor implementation. The remaining lever is deferring the popup into its own chunk (the date-picker's shape), which is a change to the mounting sequence this control's overlay placement and highlight protocol are sensitive to — not worth reopening for 0.5 KB. Revisit if the popup is extracted for other reasons.

budgetNotes../icon: Re-baselined from 3 to 2.6 when the gate moved to the linked production measure (2.34 linked against 2.74 on the published bundle), keeping the same 0.26 of headroom. budgetNotes../menu: Re-baselined from 8.5 to 7.86 when the gate moved to the linked production measure (7.76 linked against 8.41 on the published bundle), keeping the same 0.09 of headroom. The linked measure still exceeds the spec's 7, which the raises below superseded. The figures that follow are on the published-bundle measure. Of the 4.0 added, about 1.9 is the row renderer (three row shapes: link, submenu parent, item; groups; the icon forms, second line, detail, key caps and glyphs; the link and keep-open activation rules; the development diagnostics), about 0.4 the submenu overlay, about 0.4 the menu-button trigger, about 0.3 the stylesheet, about 0.2 the dismissal and key-timing rules (the release of the right-click that opened the menu, held keys, keys pressed between an open and its render), and the rest the header block, focus on open and the trigger registration in tm-menu itself. Templates ship as source text in the measured build, so the three row shapes cost their markup, not compiled code. The three Lucide glyphs (check, chevron, external link) are 0.2 KB raw. Savings taken: a trimming pass took the first measurement down by 0.14 (8.35 to 8.21, before the 0.2 of dismissal and key-timing rules): the new-tab note moved into the row's accessible name, which dropped a visually hidden element and its style rule; the description ids are minted once per row instead of in the markup; one helper types the shared row template's context in place of repeated casts; the group rule left the stylesheet; the development messages were shortened. The submenu's own Escape registration was then folded into the menu's. Options measured and not taken, none of which reaches 7: leaving the three glyphs outside the entry point gives 8.14; stripping the development diagnostics gives 8.27; moving the trigger to an entry point of its own saves about 0.4. Each drops or relocates something this entry point is specified to hold.
budgetNotes../grid: Lowered from 41.94 to 41.01 (the measured size plus 0.1 KB) by moving the tree expansion and its lazy-load batching to the tree-grid entry point, behind the tree config the tree grid hands the core, so a flat grid no longer carries them: the kept expansion set with its engine fold, emission and consumer-write effect, the active-row keeper, the batch queue with its flush and settle, the content bind and the persisted slice. The flash, the reveal and the once-per-array reconcile stay here. Measured 41.84 before (42,840 B) and 40.91 after (41,893 B; -947 B) on the linked measure from a clean build, which includes this change's review fixes (the re-flash keyframes, the pending scroll restore a reveal drops, and a bind over the outgoing rows deferring its loads). That leaves 1,115 B (1.09 KB) under the 42 hard cap (43,008 B), with the ceiling 1,014 B (0.99 KB) under it. Raised from 40.77 to 41.94 (the measured size plus about 0.1 KB) for scrollToRow and the remembered tree expansion: measured 40.68 before and 41.84 after on the linked measure (42,840 B; +1.16 KB). That left 168 B (0.16 KB) under the 42 hard cap, with the ceiling 0.06 KB under it. The weight is scrollToRow (ancestor expansion, activation in a named column, the centred or nearest reveal sharing one row-scroll helper with find, the row flash keyed by row id with its timer and token read, and the flash stylesheet with its reduced-motion and forced-colors rules) and the kept tree expansion (the expansionSource read at bind, the unpruned set with its engine fold, emission and consumer-write effect, the active-row keeper, the once-per-array reconcile, and the batched children loads with their microtask queue, model-order sort and failure path), plus the data-tm-key row attribute the tree harness reads. Savings taken: the one-row lazy-load path, the wanted-expansion set, the deferred-restore and collapse-unloaded passes and the set helpers they used were removed, and the reveal math is shared rather than repeated; the dev warning for an unknown column was shortened. Raised from 40.51 to 40.77 (the measured size plus about 0.1 KB) for the entity column's itemDescription, itemLabelParts and formatParts and the display cell that draws an entity column's text as isolated runs (the parts when they join to the display text, else one run): measured 40.42 before and 40.68 after on the linked measure (41,661 B; +0.27 KB), which leaves 1.32 KB under the 42 hard cap for scrollToRow and the tree expansion. The weight is three column inputs, the column fields that carry them, the cell view model's parts with their fall-back rule and the template branch. Savings taken (-0.07 KB published): the branch's template comment shortened to one line. Set to 40.51 for header navigation and the row-end column, on the linked production measure the gate moved to with them (every module an entry point loads linked, its deferred chunks included). At the parent (platform-core with the forced-colors range fill), ./grid measured 35.40 linked against 39.05 on the published bundle, which re-baselines its 39.25 ceiling to 35.61; after, 40.42 linked (41,385 B; +5.02 KB), with 0.09 of headroom. The spec ceiling of 42 for the list-page work holds on this measure and is a hard cap: it leaves 1.49 KB for scrollToRow and the tree expansion, and no raise goes past it. Where the 5.02 goes: the row-end cell component (its sticky band, selection fill, hairline and focus styles, and its role, index and roving tab stop bindings), the header action button (its styles, the Active description through the CDK describer, the button type and the dev-mode name check), the three template directives, the header key resolver, and the core and view: roving focus across the header row with entry from and exit to the rows, Enter, Space and Alt+ArrowDown on headers, Enter reaching an action-less header's own content, focus tracking into header actions and back from their popovers, the row-end cell joining keyboard navigation, clicks, taps, the context menu and find while staying out of selection, copy, cut and paste (its ring yielding to a grown selection, and the context menu agreeing with the keys), the header hints with the Active description on a header holding an active action, the reveal that keeps a cell clear of the sticky column, and the hairline's measurement. The figures that follow are on the published-bundle measure. Lowered from 42 to 39.25 by the read/edit split: the editing machinery (the built-in cell editors and their date, entity, select, input and number controls, the editor mount, the commit with its typed-commit search decision, and the status bar) moved to the grid-editing entry point, which an editable grid preloads when idle and a readonly grid never loads. Measured 42.00 before and 38.99 after (39,924 B; -3.01 KB); 39.01 (39,944 B) once merged with the driver fix that drops an Enter queued behind arrow keys, with about 0.24 of headroom under this ceiling. What stays here and why: the editing keys (one resolver, so the draft before the editing code arrives and the editor after it answer the same keys), commit-and-move, the draft input that takes typing while the code loads, commits on the user's gestures and hands its text and caret to the editor, with the idle preload, the bounded load and the entity commits it holds pending for the code (about 1.45 of the 39.01), the field writer (every model write, paste and the transaction API go through it) and paste label resolution. The spec ceiling for the list-page work is 42, so the header navigation, the row-end column, scrollToRow and the tree expansion still to come have 2.99 KB between them under it; each raises this ceiling by what it adds. Before the split: raised from 39 to 42 for the list-page features (row activation and its 400 ms guard, the two-way active row with the search-field driver directive, the two-way sort with its header slot, select-all across pages, row classes, optional row headers and the scrollbar gutter): measured 38.73 before and 41.92 after (+3.19 KB), the ceiling set for the grid's list features before popup editors. Review fixes (a pen long-press, a held Enter and a right-click on a cell link no longer open or move what they should not) took it to 42.00, held at the ceiling by dropping the header sort view model's flag (a header that does not sort holds no entry). About 0.8 KB is template and stylesheet text, which the published bundle carried twice (once more in the decorator metadata, which an app's production build drops); the rest is the activation, sort and active-row logic in the core, the driver and the new inputs and models. Savings taken (-0.10 KB): one cell test shared by the press, middle-click and tap paths in place of three lookups, shorter development errors and template comments. This is the third raise of this ceiling; the spec that sets 42 leaves no room for its header navigation, scrollToRow, tree expansion and row-end column, so the entry point needs the re-split this note called for. Previously raised from 38.5 to 39 for the key map through kbd and the glyphs through tm-icon: measured 38.04 before and 38.71 after (+0.68 KB). The weight is the one binding table (every key combination with its intent and help label, which the published key list is derived from), the matching loop over its letter and symbol bindings, and the Lucide data of the thirteen glyphs the find bar, status bar, tree expander and context menu now draw through tm-icon; the deleted icon-template component and the two platform sniffs give back part of it. Savings looked for and not found: the 30 label keys share a prefix that gzip already folds; drawing the glyphs through another entry point would only move their bytes, since each entry point is measured on its own weight; and the table cannot shed its intents or conditions, which the resolver runs on. This is the second raise of this ceiling under the raise-by-what-it-adds rule; a third re-splits the entry point instead. Previously raised from 38 to 38.5 for the left-to-right run around a number cell's text (formatted numbers no longer carry direction marks, so markup keeps a minus at the left of its digits in a right-to-left grid): measured 38909 B before and about 38995 B after (+85 B: one attribute binding and one view-model field, against 3 B of headroom); the touched lines held nothing to fold. Previously raised from 37 to 38 for the shared validation bubble (the cell error now renders the same component the form field does, so a cell error and a field error cannot drift apart). Previously raised from 36 to 37 for the typed-commit search rung (the editor's own search decides a commit before the column's label resolver is asked). NOTE the standing gap: spec 0004 set grid at 24 KB and the measured surface has never been near it — this ceiling has climbed 34 -> 35 -> 36 -> 37 -> 38 -> 38.5 -> 39 across four specs, each time as a ratchet over measured reality. Worth a dedicated pass rather than another increment.
